component.name: TextField
component.description: A labelled text input for collecting single-line user data. Includes a visible label, an optional error message with ARIA association, and interaction states. Use for any freeform text entry: names, emails, passwords, search terms.

useWhen: Collecting freeform single-line text from the user (name, email, password, search query)
A form field needs a visible label and optional error feedback
The value is typed, not selected — use Select for predefined option sets

notFor.because: Renders a single-line <input>; tall freeform content (bio, comments) needs a <textarea>.
notFor.note: Use a native <textarea> styled with design tokens until a TextArea component is added.

notFor.case: Using TextField for choosing from a fixed list
notFor.because: Freeform text provides no validation or keyboard-navigable option list.

useWhen.any IconName: Renders a decorative icon on the leading (left) side. Use 'search' for search inputs. Icon is aria-hidden.

useWhen.md: 40px tall. Standard form fields and inline inputs.
useWhen.lg: 48px tall. Hero search bars, prominent single-field forms.

useWhen.square: Rounded-corner rectangle (border-radius-sm). Default for form fields.
useWhen.round: Pill shape (border-radius-full). Use for search inputs or brand-forward contexts.

patterns.name: form-field-stack
patterns.useWhen: A settings or onboarding form section groups related fields under a heading.

patterns.name: inline-name-row
patterns.useWhen: Two short related fields share a row (first and last name).
